name: Miami-Dade County Public Schools
districtFact: Fourth largest school district in the United States, serving approximately 330,000 students across more than 550 schools in Miami-Dade County.

about.title: About Miami-Dade County Public Schools
about.content: Miami-Dade County Public Schools (M-DCPS) serves students across Miami-Dade County. This page focuses on the districtwide traditional elementary and secondary calendar; school events, program deadlines, and alternate program calendars may vary.

about.title: What New M-DCPS Families Should Know
about.content: Teacher planning days are no-school days for students and are listed separately from named holidays. M-DCPS also publishes official calendar PDFs in English, Spanish, and Haitian Creole.

content: Check teacher planning days separately from named holidays; students do not attend school on those dates.
Use the official district calendar and your school calendar together for campus events, testing, graduation details, and bell schedule changes.

compareIntro: Miami-Dade starts later and ends later than Broward and Palm Beach in 2026–27. All three districts list spring break for March 22–26, 2027.
comparisonTitle: Compare With Broward and Palm Beach

districtFaqs.q: How does M-DCPS handle calendar changes after hurricane closures?
districtFaqs.a: M-DCPS announces school closures and any resulting makeup-day changes through official district notices. Check the district calendar page after a weather-related closure for the latest schedule.

districtFaqs.q: Why does Miami-Dade end the school year later than most Florida districts?
districtFaqs.a: The 2026–27 M-DCPS calendar ends on Thursday, June 3, 2027. That is later than Broward and Palm Beach for this school year, so families comparing county calendars should use each district's official dates.

districtFaqs.q: Is Miami-Dade Spring Break the same week as Broward County?
districtFaqs.a: In 2026–27, Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach all list spring break for March 22–26, 2027. Teacher planning days around the break may differ by district.

districtFaqs.q: What are teacher planning days in Miami-Dade?
districtFaqs.a: Teacher planning days in M-DCPS are days when staff work but students do not attend school. They appear on the district calendar separately from state and federal holidays.

districtFaqs.q: How do I find my child's assigned school in Miami-Dade?
districtFaqs.a: M-DCPS school assignment is based on your home address and attendance zone. Use the district's School Locator on dadeschools.net for current attendance-zone information.

districtFaqs.q: Does M-DCPS publish the school calendar in Spanish?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. M-DCPS publishes official calendar PDFs in English, Spanish, and Haitian Creole. The language versions are available from the district calendar page.

livingHere.intro: Miami-Dade families should confirm the calendar type that applies to their student and check official district announcements after emergency closures.

highlights.label: Emergency Updates
highlights.detail: M-DCPS may announce calendar changes after severe weather or emergency closures. The district calendar and official notices remain the source of record for any makeup-day changes.

highlights.label: Alternate Calendars
highlights.detail: Technical colleges, adult education programs, and juvenile justice programs use separate official calendars. Check the program name before downloading a PDF.

highlights.label: Multilingual PDFs
highlights.detail: Official English, Spanish, and Haitian Creole calendar PDFs are available from M-DCPS.
